name: Royal Swiss Voile
description: Crisp, lightweight Swiss voile with fine embroidery. Drapes beautifully and stays sharp through a full owambe — perfect for that statement gele moment.

name: Blush Swiss Voile
description: Soft rose-toned voile with a whisper-light drape. Ideal for aso-ebi coordination when the party calls for something gentle and radiant.

name: Champagne Cord Lace
description: Structured cord lace with a rich champagne sheen — the same quality Lagos's top designers rely on for bridal and celebration wear.

name: Emerald Cord Lace
description: Deep emerald cordwork with a firm, sculptural hold. Commands the room at traditional ceremonies and evening events.

name: Midnight Sequins
description: Densely-set sequins on a midnight base that catches every light in the hall. For the guest who intends to be photographed.

name: Gold Cordnet Sequins
description: Cordnet base layered with gold sequins — luxurious weight, serious shimmer. A favourite for mothers of the bride.

name: Pearl Tissue Lace
description: Feather-light tissue lace scattered with pearl accents. Breathes in Lagos heat and photographs like a dream.

name: French Rosette Lace
description: Floral rosette lace with a soft scalloped edge — a timeless choice for church occasions and family celebrations.

name: Ivory Dry Lace
description: Classic dry lace with a clean matte finish and firm handfeel. Tailors love it for structured styles that hold their shape.

name: Onyx Dry Lace
description: Jet-black dry lace with a subtle geometric weave. Sharp, versatile, and endlessly re-wearable.

name: Regal Brocade
description: Heavy jacquard brocade woven with a tonal damask motif. Structured, stately, and made for agbada that means business.

name: Heritage Aso-Oke
description: Hand-woven aso-oke in deep celebration tones, made by master weavers. Sold as a full bundle for complete family sets.
